cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Replies are short, spoken-style, and give the cause and restoration time with proper opening and goodbye lines. Minor issues: "Verified na po kayo" leans slightly more Tagalog than the English-led style, and "around 12 AM, early Saturday morning" is a bit awkward compared to saying midnight or just the time.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber. This is Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang umaga. Nawalan po kasi ng internet sa bahay namin simula kaninang umaga. Gusto ko lang po malaman kung bakit at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that po. Before I check, may I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the registered mobile number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Sandali lang po, let me verify your account.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Ma'am Maria. Let me check your area now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Ma'am Maria, may fiber cable cut po along Batasan Road because of road works. Estimated restoration is around 12 AM, early Saturday morning.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, naintindihan ko po. Salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Hihintayin ko na lang po hanggang mamayang hatinggabi. Paalam po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: You're welcome po, Ma'am Maria. Thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber.
